scripts.check:fresh: d=$(mktemp -d) && tsdown --out-dir "$d" > /dev/null && diff -q "$d/mothership.pb.js" pb_hooks/mothership.pb.js && diff -q "$d/mothership.js" pb_hooks/mothership.js; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 0 ] || echo 'pb_hooks is stale. Rebuild it in a worktree (pnpm --filter pockethost-mothership-app build) and commit pb_hooks/.'; exit $s
